title: Keyboard Manager: Remap shortcut to Send Text, won't allow U+FFFD.

judgment.rationale: The reporter can enter U+FFFD in Send Text, but it disappears after saving and reopening. They confirmed that manually adding the literal character or a Unicode escape to the configuration works, narrowing the failure to editor persistence/round-trip rather than native text emission. The issue is assigned to the current owners; the proposal is a focused investigation, not a competing implementation.
evidence: The issue gives an exact U+FFFD save/reopen reproduction on PowerToys 0.84.1.
The author says the character is absent in default.json after UI save, while manually editing configuration with the literal or Unicode escape works.
The issue is assigned to MuyuanMS and Copilot; there is no linked PR.
judgment.recommended_action: Trace the Send Text editor save/load round-trip for U+FFFD and add a focused persistence regression test.

fix_assessment.rationale: The evidence localizes the loss to UI/configuration persistence. The exact serializer or validation step remains unproven and should be confirmed before changing the stored text.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve U+FFFD through the Send Text editor configuration round-trip
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Send Text editor save path may normalize, filter, or fail to persist U+FFFD even though the stored literal and JSON Unicode escape are accepted by the native remapping path. This is a hypothesis pending a save/load trace.
plan: Add a focused editor-level persistence test that enters U+FFFD, saves, reloads the mapping, and compares the exact text code point.
Trace the Send Text value through the editor binding, KeyboardMappingService, SettingsManager serialization, and reload validation to identify the first point where U+FFFD is removed.
Fix only the confirmed normalization, validation, or serialization step while preserving existing Unicode and empty-text behavior.
Add a round-trip regression for both literal U+FFFD and its JSON escape representation.
verification: The saved settings contain U+FFFD or its equivalent JSON escape after UI save.
Reopening the editor shows U+FFFD and triggering the remap emits the configured replacement character.
Existing Unicode Send Text mappings and invalid/empty mapping validation retain their behavior.

confidence.rationale: The author has isolated the UI save/reopen path and shown that manual configuration works, but the precise editor stage that drops the value has not been traced.

issue_context.summary: U+FFFD can be entered into a Keyboard Manager Send Text shortcut, but the editor drops it after save/reopen even though manually adding the character or its Unicode escape to configuration works.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.84.1 installed from GitHub.
The author and commenters distinguish the value from a mere blank display: it is absent in the JSON after UI save.
Manual configuration with the literal or Unicode escape works.
The issue is assigned to MuyuanMS and Copilot.
inferences: The defect is likely in editor save/load or validation, not the native text-emission function.
The System.Text.Json-based settings persistence and text mapping service are focused areas to trace, not confirmed causes.
issue_context.analysis: The save/reopen differential and manual-config success make an editor round-trip hypothesis testable. Because the issue is already assigned to the responsible maintainers, the design should guide a focused trace rather than start parallel work.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue and all four comments, including the author's JSON comparison and successful manual-config workaround.
Checked current assignment, labels, and linked work; no PR is linked.
Inspected SettingsManager.cs persistence and the editor/native text mapping path; no root cause is confirmed.

design.title: Preserve U+FFFD through the Send Text editor configuration round-trip

reproduce.title: Reproduce U+FFFD loss in Send Text editor save/load
prerequisites: Current upstream main or current build
A test shortcut remappable to Send Text
steps: Create a Send Text shortcut and enter the literal U+FFFD character.
Save the mapping and inspect the relevant serialized mapping value without copying unrelated settings.
Close and reopen the editor and compare the displayed value.
Repeat using a manually edited configuration containing the literal and then the escaped U+FFFD value.
reproduce.expected_result: UI-saved literal and escaped U+FFFD mappings round-trip and display the same configured code point as the manual configuration.
